name: Guidance hook pipeline (sampling_function)
plain: The order in which all guidance hooks run for one model evaluation. Knowing it explains why a pre-CFG node sees different data from a post-CFG node, and why extra negative passes are skipped at cfg 1. Hooks reading the uncond output at cfg 1 get zeros, not the cond output.
math:
1. If s ≈ 1 and disable_cfg1_optimization is false, uncond = None (one model pass; x̂_u stays an all-zero tensor, and cfg_function has no cfg=1 branch, so linear CFG gives 0+(x̂_c−0)·s).
2. outs = sampler_calc_cond_batch_function(args) if set, else calc_cond_batch(model,[cond,uncond],x,t).
3. For each sampler_pre_cfg_function: outs ← fn(conds_out=outs,...). Output space is x0/denoised.
4. cfg_function(outs[0], outs[1], s): custom sampler_cfg_function or linear, then post-CFG list.

props.extra_model_calls: 1 (cond only) or 2 (cond + uncond) by default, plus whatever hooks add

label: from code

audit.note: The first draft said uncond output equals cond at cfg 1. It is zeros.
